description: Deep Frontier new-game setup of the built-in Waterfalls map: a river falling through terraces past the central start terrace, with a badwater channel to the west and south. Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites lie just south of the start and on the north-east terrace, Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites on the western terrace and on the southern lowlands, sandstone and limestone outcrops beside their pits by the start, five Human Record Caches by the ruins, the reactor on the start terrace and the launch pad north of the start; the saved clean water is too shallow for shore fishing and the map has no room left for the Radioactive Waste Refinery.

unmet.reason: No bank qualifies for Gatherer Flag shore fishing in the saved water: the clean water is at most 0.22 deep (ShoreFishingSpec MinimumDepth 0.5, contamination at most 0.01), and all 35 water cells at least 0.5 deep are badwater (contamination 1.0). The first FreshFish needs a clean reach dammed deeper by the player.

Waterfalls has very little flat ground in large pieces: the only 20x15 reactor footprint is on the start terrace, and a greedy count finds at most 13 disjoint flat, dry 12x11 rectangles on the whole map, while the loop needs the reactor, the 12x12 launch pad, two 10x11 Deep Mines, two 11x9 Deep Drills, two 11x7 quarries, the 10x9 Archive Excavations and twelve plants of 10x9 to 12x11. An integer-program packing of every flat footprint (door cell kept free; about 27,000 candidate positions with dense positions thinned to every other cell) solved to optimality placed every site except the Radioactive Waste Refinery (12x11) and one Archive Excavation (its cache is surveyed from a neighbouring excavation); with the final layout no flat, dry, free 12x11 footprint with a routable door remains.
